cap: Each Müllerian anomaly is the step that failed. If the ducts never form, there is agenesis or one horn; if they do not fuse, two uteri or a cleft fundus; if the septum persists, a septate uterus; if the vaginal plate does not open, an obstruction such as an imperforate hymen. The mesonephric duct guides the Müllerian duct and sprouts the ureteric bud, so one-sided anomalies bring renal agenesis.
teach: Telling a septate from a bicornuate uterus needs the outside of the fundus, not the cavity: a septate uterus has a smooth or nearly smooth fundus, a bicornuate uterus a deep cleft. Müllerian agenesis (MRKH) has a 46,XX karyotype, normal ovaries and normal pubic hair, which separates it from complete androgen insensitivity. Image the kidneys in every Müllerian anomaly.
